CHS operates the platform justclaims.eu supporting air carriers with their digital claims handling – covering the entire claims handling chain from the entry of claims information through communication with the passenger and effecting payments. ​ ​ CHS Claims Handling Solutions GmbH | Güterplatz 1 | 60327 Frankfurt am Main T +49 69 380 299 910 | F +49 69 380 299 911 | E info@claims-handling.com Who is justclaims.eu/ justcourts.eu ? justclaims.eu was founded by a team of aviation attorneys in order to offer airline clients an easy and encompassing tool for their claims handling. With the number of air passenger claims skyrocketing, claim agencies gaining the upper hand and IATA forecasting the doubling of passenger demand within the next 20 years, the time-consuming handling of endless spreadsheets or clunky CRM systems will have no future. ​ justclaims provides a digital end-to-end alternative to save time and to lower costs. With a high degree of automation, efficient internal and external communication, payment solutions, detailed analytics and reporting as well as an e-billing function, the claims handling process can be centralized and significantly simplified. ​ The platform enables airlines to improve response times to passengers, enhance quality, balance out fluctuations and thus promote customer loyalty. A network of highly specialized aviation law firms supports the process or defends your interest in court – when and where necessary. ​ justclaims’ users are able to track fees, monitor legal spending, reduce overhead and stay competitive. Take us to the test and join us. ​ Find out more: www.justclaims.eu www.justcourts.eu Ulrich Steppler , LL.M., is co-founder of the CHS Claims Handling Solutions GmbH and partner of the law firm ARNECKE SIBETH DABELSTEIN where he co-heads the airline & aviation group out of the Frankfurt office. He specializes in aviation matters with a particular focus on passenger air transportation and has been representing numerous air carriers in Germany, including thousands of passenger claims. Katja H. Brecke , LL.M. (Leiden), is co-founder of the CHS Claims Handling Solutions GmbH and partner of the law firm ARNECKE SIBETH DABELSTEIN based in Frankfurt. She has been involved in numerous aviation related matters and has extensive experience in representing passenger airlines and supporting them throughout the claims handling process. https://www.claims-handling.com/privacy-.text: --> Privacy Policy | claims-handling.de top of page Privacy Policy 1. Subject matter of this privacy statement ​ We appreciate your interest in our website and our offers on our websites (hereafter referred to as “justcourts ”) ​ Our main aim is the protection of your personal data (hereafter referred to as “data”). In the following we would like to inform you in detail about what data are collected during your visit to our website and the use of our offers and how we process or use the data hereafter, as well as which accompanying protective measures we have taken in technical and organizational terms. ​ 2. Responsible body/ service provider ​ Responsible body in terms of the Federal Data Protection Act (BDSG) and at the same time service provider in terms of the Telemedia Act (TMG) is ​ CHS Claims Handling Solutions GmbH Güterplatz 1 60327 Frankfurt am Main T +49 69 380 299 910 E info@claims-handling.com ​ Managing directors: Ulrich Steppler Katja H. Brecke ​ The CHS Claims Handling Solutions GmbH is registered in the commercial register of the Frankfurt am Main Local Court under HRB 108923. ​ If you have any questions or comments about this privacy statement or about data protection in general, please send them to the following e-mail address info@claims-handling.com . ​ 3. Collection and use of data ​ At the moment you can only use our website for informational purposes. For the in-formational use of our website, it is not necessary for you to provide data. In this case, we only collect and use the data that your internet browser automatically transmits to us, such as for example: ​ date and time of access to one of our websites our browser type the browser settings the operated system used your last visited page the amount of data transferred and the access status (file transferred, file not found, etc.) as well as your IP-address. ​ We collect and use this data during an informational visit exclusively in a non-personalized form. This is done in order to enable the use of the websites you have accessed, for statistic purposes and to improve our internet offer. The IP-address is only stored for the duration of your visit, no person-related analysis takes place. ​ 4. Use of cookies ​ We use the technology of cookies for our website. Cookies are small text files that are sent to your browser by our web server during your visit to our website, who stores it on your computer for later retrieval. ​ We only use so-called session cookies (also referred to as temporary cookies), i.e. those that are only stored temporarily for the duration of your use of one of our web-sites. The purpose of those cookies is the continuous identification of your computer during your visit to one of our websites and the switch to another of our websites and to ascertain the end of your visit. ​ The cookies are deleted as soon as you end your browser session. ​ Whether cookies can be set and retrieved can be determined by the settings in your browser. For example, you can completely deactivate the storage of cookies in your browser, restrict it to certain web pages or configure your browser in such a way that it automatically notifies you, as soon as a cookie is to be set and asks you for a response. However, for technical reasons, it is necessary to allow session cookies on behalf of the functionality of our website. ​ We do not collect or store personal data in cookies in this context. ​ 5. Data security ​ We also use technical and organizational security measures to protect the incoming or collected personal data, in particular against accidental or intentional manipulation, loss, destruction or against the attack of unauthorized persons. Our security measures are continuously improved in line with technological developments.
